# Getting help

Thanks for using **android-agent**. Here is where to go, depending on what you
need.

## Questions and usage help
- **GitHub Discussions** — for "how do I…", setup help, and open-ended
  questions: https://github.com/andreshma/android-agent/discussions
- Read the docs first: the [README](../README.md) and the guides under
  [`docs/`](../docs) (usage, examples, threat model, testing).

## Bugs and feature requests
- Open an **issue** with the matching template:
  https://github.com/andreshma/android-agent/issues/new/choose
- Please include your OS, Python version, the exact command, and the output
  (redact anything sensitive). For device actions, say which phone and ROM.

## Security vulnerabilities
- **Do not** open a public issue. Follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) and use
  GitHub's private vulnerability reporting:
  https://github.com/andreshma/android-agent/security/advisories/new

## Before you ask
- Check existing [issues](https://github.com/andreshma/android-agent/issues) and
  [discussions](https://github.com/andreshma/android-agent/discussions) — your
  question may already be answered.
- This is a volunteer-maintained alpha project; responses are best-effort.
